name: Azumino G Sakurako
source:
She is an English teacher who is popular with both boys and girls. She is half Japanese and half American. She is mostly American on the outside and 70% American on the inside.

She is fluent in both Japanese and English, and speaks smoothly in both languages. She was a cheerleader during her school days and has an affinity for sports.

She has a cheerful and dynamic personality with a wide range of emotions.  She is confident and mischievous. She is very caring and a bit of a big sister.
